experience.title: Python Developer Intern

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a medical AI data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset — augmentation, batch-loading, and memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.

experience.title: Research Intern

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR Pipeline from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR AI application: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 6-block causal Transformer decoder, trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples achieving 15% WER.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with Cython-accelerated backend — 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm — MS Capstone, RIT

Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini LLM intent classification (<500ms), and TensorRT YOLO at ~18 FPS; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Resolved 11 integration failures to reach production-reliable performance.
